chapters.title: Nature and Significance of Management
topics: Management as art, science and profession

flashcards.front: Why is coordination called the essence of management?
flashcards.back: Coordination integrates individual efforts, harmonises activities and ensures that organisational goals are achieved together.

flashcards.front: What are the three levels of management?
flashcards.back: Top, middle and supervisory management. They differ in authority, responsibility and time horizon.

questions.prompt: Which feature of management refers to achieving goals with minimum cost?
questions.explanation: Efficiency means completing work with minimum cost and optimum use of resources.

questions.prompt: State two points that show management is a continuous process.
questions.explanation: Management involves continuous planning, organising, staffing, directing and controlling.

flashcards.front: What are the four Ps of the marketing mix?
flashcards.back: Product, price, place and promotion. Together they shape how an offering reaches and serves its market.
Branding gives a product a distinct name, term, sign, symbol or design that differentiates it from competitors.

questions.prompt: Explain any three functions of packaging.
questions.explanation: Packaging protects the product, facilitates handling and storage, helps in promotion and provides convenience to consumers.

questions.prompt: A product marked at ₹1,000 is sold after a 10% discount. Find the selling price.
questions.explanation: Discount is ₹100, so the selling price is ₹1,000 − ₹100 = ₹900.
